This creates a more natural looking rotation. guard gestureRecognizer.view != nil else { return } if gestureRecognizer.state == .began || gestureRecognizer.state == .changed { gestureRecognizer.view?.transform = gestureRecognizer.view!.transform.rotated(by: gestureRecognizer.rotation) gestureRecognizer.rotation = 0 } } ```
